name: System Level Primitive Sharding
definition: A distributed rendering strategy that partitions a global Gaussian model across M GPUs to handle city-scale scenes with hundreds of millions of primitives, ensuring storage and per-step compute scale with GPU count.
summary: System Level Primitive Sharding distributes 3D Gaussian Splatting across GPUs via index parity, eliminating spatial boundary waste and merge steps inherent in block partitioning.
